launch.offline: Can't reach the interview service. Check your internet connection.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of the app can no longer be used. Install version {version} or later to take your interview.
update.bodyNoVersion: This version of the app can no longer be used. Install the latest version to take your interview.
update.installing: Installing. The app restarts by itself when it is done.
update.restart: The update is installed. Close the app and open it again to continue.
update.upToDate: No update is available for this computer yet. Use the download link, or try again later.

errors.network: Can't reach the update service. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.server: The update service had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.signature: The update couldn't be verified, so it wasn't installed. Download the latest version instead.
errors.unavailable: No update is available for this computer yet. Use the download link, or try again later.
errors.failed: The update didn't install. Try again, or download the latest version.

signIn.title: Sign in to your interview
signIn.intro: Use the email address and password from your interview invitation.
signIn.updateAvailable: A newer version of the app is available. You can update after your interview.
signIn.sessionExpired: You were signed out. Sign in again to continue.

code.title: Check your email
code.intro: This is a new device, so we sent a 6-digit code to {sentTo}.
code.label: Code
code.resent: A new code is on its way.

interviews.title: Your interviews
interviews.empty: You have no interviews to take right now.
interviews.thirdEyeRequired: Needs your phone as a second camera
interviews.thirdEyeOptional: You may use your phone as a second camera

checks.title: System check
checks.intro: We check that your computer is ready. This takes about a minute.
checks.mustFix: Fix the items marked as failed, then check again.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.body: Your computer passed the check and your consent is recorded. The interview starts as soon as you press Start.

errors.third-eye-required: This interview needs your phone as a second camera first.
errors.media-unavailable: The interview service is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.checks-incomplete: Run the system check again before starting.
errors.interview-expired: The window for this interview has closed.
errors.resume-limit-reached: This interview can't be resumed again. Contact the company.
errors.unknown: The interview couldn't start. Try again.

errors.invalid-credentials: That email address and password don't match.
errors.account-locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.account-disabled: This account can't sign in. Contact the company that invited you.
errors.no-interview: You have no interview assigned right now.
errors.job-closed: The job for this interview is no longer open.
errors.interview-not-available: This interview can't be taken right now.
errors.interview-expired: The window for this interview has closed.
errors.otp-expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.otp-attempts-exceeded: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.network: Can't reach the interview service. Check your internet connection.

guidance.title: Your camera view
guidance.ok: We can see your face clearly.
guidance.unavailable: Face guidance isn't available right now. You can still continue.
guidance.obstructed: Your camera looks covered or blocked. Uncover the lens.
guidance.no_face: We can't see your face. Sit in front of the camera and face it.
guidance.multiple_faces: We can see more than one person. Make sure you're alone in the camera view.
guidance.too_dark: Your face is hard to see. Add light in front of you, not behind you.
guidance.too_far: You're far from the camera. Move a little closer.
guidance.too_close: You're very close to the camera. Move back a little.
guidance.off_centre: Move so your face is in the center of the picture.

nudges.FACE_ABSENT: We can't see your face. Please stay in front of the camera.
nudges.MULTIPLE_FACES: We can see more than one person. Please make sure you're alone.
nudges.FACE_TOO_FAR: Please move a little closer to the camera.
nudges.FACE_TOO_CLOSE: Please move back from the camera a little.
nudges.CAMERA_OBSTRUCTED: Your camera looks blocked. Please uncover it.

briefing.title: Before you start
briefing.textMode: You'll answer in writing: type each answer and send it.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.intro: Choose what you agree to. Required items are needed to take this interview; if you can't agree to one, you can ask for an accommodation instead.
consent.accommodationIntro: Tell the company what you need. A recruiter reviews your request before the interview.
consent.note: Anything else the recruiter should know
consent.requested: Your request was sent. You'll hear back by email.

interview.title: Interview
interview.typeInstead: Prefer to type? Write your answer here
interview.servicesProblem: Some of the checks that protect your interview didn't start. Please keep this window open; the app is trying again.

completed.title: Thank you
completed.body: Your interview is finished. Please keep this window open until your recordings have finished uploading.
completed.uploading: {percent}% uploaded. {pending, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} still to go.
completed.keepOpen: Please don't close the app yet.
completed.safeToClose: Everything is uploaded. It's safe to close the app.
completed.gaps: {count, plural, one {# part of your recording couldn't be uploaded, so the recording will have a gap.} other {# parts of your recording couldn't be uploaded, so the recording will have gaps.}}
